# GABBE (Generative Architectural Brain Base Engine)

> GABBE is a universal, runtime-agnostic Markdown "agentic engineering kit" that turns any AI coding agent (Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, Cline, Aider, Gemini, Antigravity, OpenCode, Zed, Continue, Roo Code, Kilo Code, GitHub Copilot, OpenAI/Codex, VS Code) into a governed software engineering team. It ships 180 skills, 73 guides, 34 personas, and 78+ templates, plus an optional experimental Python CLI (`gabbe`) providing budget/policy/audit/MCP controls. Current version: 0.9.6. License: Apache-2.0 (code) AND CC-BY-SA-4.0 (content).

This file follows the llms.txt convention (https://llmstxt.org). It gives an agent the essential, accurate technical facts to use or integrate GABBE, then links to the deeper docs. All links are canonical GitHub `main` URLs and are fetchable.

## How GABBE works (read this first if you are an agent operating inside a GABBE-enabled repo)

- The kit lives under `agents/`. The operating contract is `agents/AGENTS.md` (the every-session operating loop) governed by `agents/CONSTITUTION.md` (hard invariants: Articles I–X — security, cost, spec-driven, observability, human-in-the-loop).
- On install, the kit is emitted into each agent's native location: `.claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md` (Claude), `.cursor/rules/*.mdc` (Cursor), `.github/skills/` (VS Code/Copilot), `.gemini/`, and the universal `.agents/skills/<slug>/SKILL.md` tree (read by Antigravity, OpenCode, and any agentskills.io-compatible tool). `AGENTS.md` is also linked as `CLAUDE.md` / `.cursorrules` / `copilot-instructions.md`.
- Operating spine each session: **preflight → clarify → act → state-preserve → final-review**. A `RESUME_POINTER` in `agents/memory/` is the lifeline — current task + NEXT ACTION — so a token/time/crash cutoff never loses progress.
- State is portable: `agents/scripts/state_export.sh` / `state_import.sh` move full working state (memory, tasks, config) between agents/LLMs so work continues continuously elsewhere.
- Two cognition modes: **Brain Mode** (System 2 — Active Inference + evolutionary prompt optimization, meta-cognitive orchestration) wraps **Loki Mode** (System 1 — a 10-phase SDLC state machine, S01–S10, with human approval gates) run by 30+ specialized personas.
- Autonomy posture `GABBE_AUTONOMY` ∈ `ask | auto | hybrid` (default `hybrid`; precedence: env var > `project/gabbe.config.json` > default). Levels L0–L3 scale how much the agent acts vs. asks; expensive/irreversible/SOTA actions always require human approval.

## Install

- Node (Python-independent, recommended): `npx gabbe init` — bundles the kit and wires every agent. Non-interactive: `npx gabbe init --agents claude,cursor,antigravity,opencode --yes`.
- Shell: `curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/andreibesleaga/GABBE/main/install.sh | sh` (PowerShell: `install.ps1`).
- Python: `pip install gabbe` (or pipx/uvx), then `gabbe setup`. The full Markdown kit ships in the **sdist** only (it lives outside the importable `gabbe` package); a plain wheel install gets the CLI but not the kit — use `npx gabbe init` for the kit without Python.
- Fill kit placeholders interactively: `python scripts/fill_placeholders.py`.

## Optional CLI (`gabbe`) — experimental platform control layer

The Markdown kit works with zero Python. The optional CLI adds enforcement. Verbs:

- `gabbe init` (init SQLite state), `gabbe db`, `gabbe sync` (bidirectional `project/TASKS.md` ↔ DB), `gabbe verify` (programmable integrity: files/tests/lint), `gabbe status` (dashboard), `gabbe setup` (install wizard).
- `gabbe brain activate | evolve | heal` (Active Inference loop / evolutionary prompt optimization / self-heal; needs an API key), `gabbe route` (cost router local vs remote), `gabbe forecast` (cost/token projection).
- `gabbe serve-mcp` (fail-closed JSON-RPC MCP gateway: requires a token + command allowlist), `gabbe runs`, `gabbe audit <run-id>` (span trace), `gabbe replay <run-id>` (deterministic replay), `gabbe resume <run-id>` (approve/reject escalations).
- `gabbe registry publish | add` (agentskills.io interop).

Control surfaces: Budget (tokens/cost/tool-calls/iterations/wall-time + `can_afford()`/`reserve()`), HardStop (absolute guards), PolicyEngine (YAML RBAC + allowlists, **fail-closed** — deny-all when no/empty policy), ToolGateway (single mediated execution point; **fail-closed** schema validation via required `jsonschema`), AuditTracer (SQLite + JSONL + optional OTel GenAI spans, PII/secret redaction by default), EscalationHandler, CheckpointStore.

## Configuration (environment variables)

Read at runtime from `.env` or the OS environment (`gabbe/config.py`). Key vars:
`GABBE_API_KEY`, `GABBE_API_URL`, `GABBE_API_MODEL`, `GABBE_AUTONOMY`, `GABBE_MAX_TOKENS_PER_RUN`, `GABBE_MAX_COST_USD`, `GABBE_MAX_TOOL_CALLS_PER_RUN`, `GABBE_MAX_ITERATIONS`, `GABBE_MAX_WALL_TIME`, `GABBE_MAX_RECURSION_DEPTH`, `GABBE_MAX_RETRIES_PER_TOOL`, `GABBE_LLM_TEMPERATURE`, `GABBE_LLM_TIMEOUT`, `GABBE_LLM_MAX_RETRIES`, `GABBE_LLM_CACHE` (opt-in deterministic response cache), `GABBE_POLICY_FILE`, `GABBE_ESCALATION_MODE`, `GABBE_OTEL_ENABLED`, `GABBE_MCP_TOKEN`, `GABBE_MCP_ALLOWED_COMMANDS`, `GABBE_ROUTE_THRESHOLD`, `GABBE_SUBPROCESS_TIMEOUT`, `GABBE_LOG_LEVEL`. Per-project config: `project/gabbe.config.json` (autonomy, budgets, model tiers, enabled MCPs, registries).

## Repository layout

- `agents/` — the kit: `AGENTS.md`, `CONSTITUTION.md`, `skills/` (180 `*.skill.md`), `guides/` (73), `personas/` (34), `templates/` (78+), `memory/`, `scripts/` (install + state export/import + skill compilation).
- `gabbe/` — the optional Python CLI (fully typed, `mypy --strict` clean): `main.py`, `brain.py`, `budget.py`, `policy.py`, `gateway.py`, `audit.py`, `sync.py`, `route.py`, `escalation.py`, `replay.py`, `config.py`, …
- `bin/install.js` — Node installer. `install.sh` / `install.ps1` — shell installers. `scripts/` — `init.py`, `registry_export.py`, `registry_import.py`, gates, tests.
- `docs/` — full documentation. `project/` — runtime state (DB, TASKS.md, policies).

## Quality & compatibility guarantees

- 480+ tests (`pytest`); `scripts/verify_all.sh` runs a 13-check battery; `mypy --strict` clean on the 21 core modules; ruff + black clean.
- 6 backward-compatibility gates on every change: API surface, CLI `--help` byte-equal, config schema superset, DB schema superset, emitter golden vault, CVE delta (`osv-scanner`/`pip-audit`).
- Drift-prevention consistency gates (9 invariants) + capability-layer validators (skills/links/use-cases/frontmatter).
- Security defaults: fail-closed policy + gateway, redacted observability, hardened untrusted-archive import, SBOM (CycloneDX 1.6) attached to every release.

## Agent contract (the governing instructions)

- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/andreibesleaga/GABBE/blob/main/agents/AGENTS.md): The every-session operating loop — mandates (skill-selection, cost, spec-driven, observability, collaboration), Steps 0–7, self-evolve, HITL, continuity/portability, tool overrides.
- [CONSTITUTION.md](https://github.com/andreibesleaga/GABBE/blob/main/agents/CONSTITUTION.md): Hard invariants (Articles I–X) that override task objectives — security, no destructive ops without approval, budget limits, no silent failures.
- [Skills index](https://github.com/andreibesleaga/GABBE/blob/main/agents/skills): 180 specialized `*.skill.md` capabilities (each with `name`/`description`/`triggers` frontmatter).
- [Guides index](https://github.com/andreibesleaga/GABBE/blob/main/agents/guides/00-index.md): 73 language/domain/process guides (incl. the Loki 10-phase SDLC).
- [Personas index](https://github.com/andreibesleaga/GABBE/blob/main/agents/personas/00-index.md): 34 specialized roles (architect, implementer, security auditor, QA, orchestrators).
